integrity: The proof is self-contained. The verifier exhausts naturally labeled posets through six vertices and independently checks the antichain-pair formula and both stability inequalities; it is a consistency check rather than a substitute for the proof.
limitations: The theorem concerns complete 1-types over finite parameter sets in the random poset, not higher-arity types. The extremal proof is elementary, so unindexed folklore remains a residual originality risk.
title: Sharp chain–antichain envelope for finite-parameter 1-types of the random poset
